deepReviewPass.description: Current Deep Scan discovery pass. Send it when starting each pass together with that pass's total and zero completed items.

phase.description: Current workflow phase. Send it immediately when the scan enters a new phase so persisted progress advances.

phaseItemsCompleted.description: Completed authoritative coverage, receipts, or artifacts for the current phase. Increase it only after the corresponding work product exists.

phaseItemsTotal.description: Expected authoritative coverage, receipts, or artifacts for the current phase. Increase it before newly discovered work begins.

phaseProgressUnit.description: What phaseItemsTotal and phaseItemsCompleted count for the current phase.

preflightChecks.description: Current standard or diff scan preflight results. Project every helper results entry to capability, reason, severity, and status only. The server derives the item counts and visible block/warn attention items.

reviewItemsCompleted.description: Cumulative completed reviews or coverage surfaces in the current discovery pass. Increment only after the corresponding review is complete.

reviewItemsTotal.description: Expected reviews or coverage surfaces in the current discovery pass. Increase it before assigning newly discovered work.

handoffClaimToken.description: Opaque continuation token returned by the native launcher. Pass it on every progress, completion, or failure update after a resume.

list_codex_security_repositories.title: List Codex Security Repositories
list_codex_security_repositories.description: App-only. Read plugin-owned repository summaries and their latest scan state. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

list_codex_security_global_findings.name: list_codex_security_global_findings
list_codex_security_global_findings.title: List Codex Security Global Findings
list_codex_security_global_findings.description: App-only. Read the latest plugin-owned finding occurrence for each stable repository target and finding identity. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

list_codex_security_scans.title: List Codex Security Scans
list_codex_security_scans.description: App-only. Read persisted plugin-owned scan summaries for native Security navigation. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

read_codex_security_artifact.name: read_codex_security_artifact
read_codex_security_artifact.title: Read Codex Security Artifact
read_codex_security_artifact.description: Read a saved supplemental artifact from temporary or persistent storage, including after an MCP restart. Use the same scanId or standalone targetPath, storage and relative path used to save it. A scan's host-generated model is threatmodel.md; standalone legacy threat_model.md remains readable. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

request_codex_security_user_input.name: request_codex_security_user_input
request_codex_security_user_input.title: Request Codex Security User Input
request_codex_security_user_input.description: Fallback for interactive Codex Security workflows when the host-native request_user_input tool is unavailable. Presents one to three non-sensitive multiple-choice questions through standard MCP form elicitation and waits for the user's response. Never call this tool in headless, automation, or other non-interactive sessions. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

questions.description: One to three non-sensitive multiple-choice questions for an interactive Codex Security workflow.

list_codex_security_findings.name: list_codex_security_findings
list_codex_security_findings.title: List Codex Security Findings
list_codex_security_findings.description: App-only. Load one bounded page of indexed findings for a completed local scan, migrating validated legacy finding details when needed. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

prepare_codex_security_review_items.name: prepare_codex_security_review_items
prepare_codex_security_review_items.title: Prepare Codex Security Review Items
prepare_codex_security_review_items.description: Generate the changed-file inventory for a diff scan. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

record_codex_security_scan_draft.name: record_codex_security_scan_draft
record_codex_security_scan_draft.title: Record Codex Security Scan Draft
record_codex_security_scan_draft.description: Save the canonical threat model, findings and coverage as an unsealed draft. Use complete:false as soon as a model is available, even with empty findings and partial coverage, then for progress checkpoints; use complete:true for the final result. The host derives threatmodel.md. Keep unvalidated candidates in coverage.deferred. On terminal Standard or diff drafts, close generic review tasks with coverage.resolvedDeferred:[{id,reason}], copying IDs from the returned coverage. Update linked surfaces by their saved IDs. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

complete.description: Set false to save progress without declaring this worker or parent audit finished. Omit or set true only for the terminal result. Put provisional candidates in coverage.deferred, not findings.

set_codex_security_finding_triage.name: set_codex_security_finding_triage
set_codex_security_finding_triage.title: Update Codex Security Finding Status
set_codex_security_finding_triage.description: App-only. Persist a completed finding's local open or closed triage status. Closed findings require one bounded close reason; reopening clears it. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

cancel_codex_security_scan.name: cancel_codex_security_scan
cancel_codex_security_scan.title: Cancel Codex Security Scan
cancel_codex_security_scan.description: Stop a running scan from its owning Codex thread, prevent further progress or completion updates, and cancel any active deterministic Deep Scan SDK workers. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

record_codex_security_scan_draft.name: record_codex_security_scan_draft
record_codex_security_scan_draft.title: Record Codex Security Scan Draft
record_codex_security_scan_draft.description: Save the canonical threat model, findings and coverage as an unsealed draft. Use complete:false as soon as a model is available, even with empty findings and partial coverage, then for progress checkpoints; use complete:true for the final result. The host derives threatmodel.md. Keep unvalidated candidates in coverage.deferred. On terminal Standard or diff drafts, close generic review tasks with coverage.resolvedDeferred:[{id,reason}], copying IDs from the returned coverage. Update linked surfaces by their saved IDs. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

complete.description: Set false to save progress without declaring this worker or parent audit finished. Omit or set true only for the terminal result. Put provisional candidates in coverage.deferred, not findings.

scope.description: The modeled source scope, which may differ from the scan scope. Omit when unknown.

threatModel.description: Retained threat-model content. Existing structured models remain supported; Markdown documents preserve their complete original body.

ruleId.description: A stable lowercase vulnerability-family slug, such as prototype-pollution.json-patch; a CWE is taxonomy, not a rule ID.

category.description: The actual primary broken security control, not a CWE identifier.

cwe.description: Copy the reviewed candidate's exact cwe_ids array. Use an empty array when no CWE is established; do not invent one.

code.description: The genuine, nonempty source snippet at this evidence location.

sourceFindingIds.description: Host-provided source finding references represented by this Deep reduction. Preserve every assigned reference exactly once.

sourceFindings.description: Original source payloads retained by the host for lossless semantic merges.

source.description: The actual finding producer. Use local_plugin only for a finding discovered by this plugin.

completeness.description: Use partial if any work is deferred or any surface needs follow-up; use complete only when no such work remains.

label.description: The meaningful name of the reviewed security surface.

disposition.description: The evidence-supported review result for this surface.

deferred.description: Each supplied id identifies one task and must be unique within this draft. Reuse saved IDs in later updates.

resolvedDeferred.description: On final Standard or diff drafts, close generic tasks by saved ID and completion reason. Reuse saved surface IDs for updates. Candidate tasks need findings or dispositions; redundant closure entries for those outcomes are ignored.

get_codex_security_daybreak_access.name: get_codex_security_daybreak_access
get_codex_security_daybreak_access.title: Check Codex Security Daybreak Access
get_codex_security_daybreak_access.description: Check this ChatGPT account's Daybreak access and available Daybreak programs. This check is advisory and never authorizes or blocks a scan. Skip it for Amazon Bedrock scans: it does not check AWS model access or access to local CLI results. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

cancel_codex_security_finding_remediatio.name: cancel_codex_security_finding_remediation_request
cancel_codex_security_finding_remediatio.title: Cancel Codex Security Finding Remediation Request
cancel_codex_security_finding_remediatio.description: App-only. Roll back an owned remediation request after the user declines its host follow-up. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

list_codex_security_candidates.name: list_codex_security_candidates
list_codex_security_candidates.title: List Codex Security Candidates
list_codex_security_candidates.description: Read one page of diff or Deep scan discovery candidates. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

record_codex_security_discovery_candidat.name: record_codex_security_discovery_candidates
record_codex_security_discovery_candidat.title: Record Codex Security Discovery Candidates
record_codex_security_discovery_candidat.description: Normalize and replace the selected diff scan's candidates. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

attach_codex_security_scan_continuation_.title: Attach Codex Security Scan Thread
attach_codex_security_scan_continuation_.description: App-only. Persist the normal local Codex thread created for a claimed scan handoff. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

mark_codex_security_finding_remediation_.name: mark_codex_security_finding_remediation_delivered
mark_codex_security_finding_remediation_.title: Mark Codex Security Finding Remediation Delivered
mark_codex_security_finding_remediation_.description: App-only. Seal host-message delivery ownership before Codex starts a remediation worker. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

recover_codex_security_scan_results.title: Recover Codex Security Scan Results
recover_codex_security_scan_results.description: App-only. Explicitly validate and republish retained checkpoints for one stopped scan, updating its artifacts, finding index, and counts. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

set_codex_security_finding_remediation.name: set_codex_security_finding_remediation
set_codex_security_finding_remediation.title: Update Codex Security Finding Remediation
set_codex_security_finding_remediation.description: Persist the bounded local remediation workflow state for a completed finding. The UI may mark a request as queued; Codex records generated, applied, verifying, verified, or failed states after performing the corresponding work. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

start_codex_security_deep_scan.name: start_codex_security_deep_scan
start_codex_security_deep_scan.title: Start or Join Codex Security Deep Scan
start_codex_security_deep_scan.description: Run or rejoin independent Standard security scans and semantically merge their validated findings. Pass scanId and its handoffClaimToken to resume, or targetPath to start headlessly. The call blocks until the aggregate draft is ready, fails, or is canceled. On success, use the returned scanId and scanDir; manifestPath identifies the canonical parent scan-manifest.json. Call complete_codex_security_scan once. This tool is part of plugin `Codex Security`.

scanId.description: Existing app-created or previously returned Deep Scan ID.
